title: Articled Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
Jain Prerna & Co. is a professional accounting and advisory firm committed to delivering reliable, accurate, and timely financial services to individuals and organizations. The firm focuses on building long-term client relationships through integrity, transparency, and personalized service. Team members are encouraged to develop strong technical skills and professional judgment in a supportive learning environment. Jain Prerna & Co. offers exposure to a variety of assignments, helping aspiring professionals gain practical experience and grow in their careers.

**Role Description**
The Articled Assistant will work full time on-site at the Jain Prerna & Co. office in Sonipat. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting with audits, tax return preparation, accounting entries, and financial statement compilation under the guidance of senior team members. The role involves maintaining working papers, supporting documentation, and client records in an organized and accurate manner. The Articled Assistant will also help in conducting basic financial analysis, complying with relevant standards and regulations, and coordinating with clients for data collection and clarification. This position provides hands-on training, exposure to professional ethics, and opportunities to learn firm procedures and best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong basics in accounting principles, financial reporting, and taxation.
* Candidates should possess skills in using spreadsheets and accounting software, along with general computer literacy.
* Candidates should possess good analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Candidates should possess effective written and verbal communication skills to interact with team members and clients.
* Candidates should possess time-management and organizational skills to handle multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
* Enrollment in or completion of a relevant professional course (such as CA or equivalent) is highly beneficial.
* Willingness to learn, maintain professional ethics, and work collaboratively in a team environment is essential.

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
NTNNEI MANUFACTURING INDIA PVT LTD is an industrial manufacturing organization operating in India with a facility in Rewari. The company focuses on delivering reliable, high-quality manufactured products to domestic and international customers. It emphasizes operational efficiency, process discipline, and continuous improvement in its production and support functions. Team members are encouraged to contribute to streamlined workflows and robust compliance practices, especially in finance and accounting. The organization values professionals who support accurate financial reporting and strong internal controls to enable sustainable growth.
  
**Role Description**
The Accountant role is a full-time, on-site position based in Rewari. The individual in this role will handle day-to-day accounting activities, including posting journal entries, maintaining ledgers, reconciling bank and vendor accounts, and managing accounts payable and receivable. Responsibilities include preparing invoices, monitoring payments, assisting with monthly and annual closing, and supporting the preparation of financial statements and management reports. The Accountant will ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards, tax regulations, and internal policies, while coordinating with internal departments and external auditors as needed. The role also involves maintaining accurate documentation, supporting budgeting and cost tracking, and contributing to process improvements in the finance function.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of general accounting principles, ledger maintenance, and account reconciliation.
* Ability to manage accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, billing, and cash/bank transactions.
* Experience in preparing financial reports, assisting with month-end/year-end closing, and supporting audits.
* Understanding of taxation, compliance, and statutory reporting relevant to manufacturing or industrial organizations.
* Proficiency with accounting software and MS Excel; familiarity with ERP systems is an advantage.
* Excellent attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and organizational skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field; professional certifications (such as CA/CPA or equivalent) are a plus.
* Prior experience in an accounting role within a manufacturing or industrial environment is preferred.
